question: In 2021, approximately what was the percentage of urban population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **35.4%.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Urbanization in India **

 
 
• India's adoption of a mixed economy, which led to the growth of the private sector, accelerated urbanization shortly **after independence.**
 
• India's urban population was** 11.4% as of the 1901** census, rising to **28.53% by the 2001** census and **34% in 2017**, according to The **World Bank**.
 
• A UN survey predicts that** 40.76%** of the country's population will live in urban areas by **2030.**
 
• According to the **2011 census,** **Delhi **has** 28 million** people and experienced the world's fastest rate of urbanization, with a **4.1% increase** in population.
